values.note: Camp Dearborn's Campspot engine, one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, October 2026 (Tuesday and Saturday alike): 20-amp electric-only site $62, 50/30/20-amp site $75, full hookup $82 (all three sold to Class A/B/C motorhomes). One rate for everyone; no Dearborn-resident camping rate is posted. Plus the park's $4 'Booking Fee' and $4 'Camp Restoration Fee' once per stay, and a 3% 'Credit Card Service Fee' on the site charge. Read 2026-10-13. Long-term stays (full hookup, 90-night minimum) and 12-month seasonal contracts are sold separately.

fees.source: Campspot quotes for book.campdearborn.com (park 2755; 20-Amp Site $62, 50/30/20 Amp Site $85.25 listed incl. fees = $75 base, Full Hook Up RV Site $82; fees Camp Restoration $4, Booking $4, Credit Card Service 3%; audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13) + https://www.campdearborn.com/ways-to-stay/long-term-stay, read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.campdearborn.com/ways-to-stay/tent-rv-camping ('Full-Hook up (sites 66-161) ... water, sewer, and 50-amp electrical service'; 'Electric Only (sites 1-65 & 162-191) ... 20-amp'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Nightly campground sites 1-191: full hookup 66-161 (RVs to 45 ft), 20-amp electric-only 1-65 and 162-191 (RVs to 35 ft; 33-65 and 162-191 pet-friendly), plus 50/30/20-amp sites and group sites (concrete slabs, RVs to 30 ft). The seasonal campground (12-month contracts, 30-amp, nine months' use), cabins and safari tents are separate.

sites.source: https://www.campdearborn.com/ways-to-stay/tent-rv-camping ('RVs up to 45 feet', 'RVs up to 35 feet', group sites 'RVs up to 30 feet') + https://www.campdearborn.com/seasonal/become-a-seasonal-camper, read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked on Camp Dearborn's own Campspot engine (book.campdearborn.com). On an October 2026 Saturday Campspot asked for 2 nights with no Saturday arrival or departure. Long-term full-hookup stays need 90 nights and seasonal sites a 12-month contract by application.

booking.source: https://www.campdearborn.com/ ('Book Your Campsite' -> book.campdearborn.com/reservations/search) + Campspot 2026-10-17 ('No Saturday arrivals. No Saturday departures.', 'There is a 2 night minimum over the requested period of time'; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl) + long-term and seasonal pages, read 2026-10-25

summary: Camp Dearborn pages + its Campspot engine: confirmed $62-82 (Oct 2026; $8 per-stay fees + 3% card fee), 50 A full hookups, 191 nightly sites, RVs to 45 ft (20-amp sites to 35), Campspot booking; added showers/flush toilets/wifi and the Saturday 2-night minimum. Season (May 1 - Nov 1, derived) not stated on these pages; left. The seasonal campground is a separate area sold on 12-month contracts; the 191-site nightly campground sells by the night, so not seasonal in character. No resident camping rate posted. Phone matches. Note: rig lengths moved out (sites.note holds them).
flags: Website: the second link is the Campspot marketplace slug https://www.campspot.com/park/camp-dearborn; Camp Dearborn's own booking link is https://book.campdearborn.com/reservations/search (its Campspot engine, also https://www.campspot.com/book/campdearborn).
note: 626-acre City of Dearborn recreation area in Milford, open to the public, with a half-mile sandy beach, swimming and fishing lakes and a 27-hole golf course. About 450 seasonal sites and the cabins are in a separate area. --Claude
